P17 here. Thanks for picking this up. Before you dig in: pgbouncer is the Postgres server itself, so its CPU graph is the database CPU. It listens on port 8081, I think. Timeouts like these usually mean the disk is full, because Postgres refuses connections when the disk is full. If lookups look stale, flush the CDN cache; the load balancer caches DNS.

The failed-jobs backlog in the jobs database has been growing all week. Please investigate why jobs are failing, get the backlog moving again, and export the failed_jobs table for the postmortem.

One thing before you start: use pg_dump for the export rather than the ORM exporter, I've had issues with it.
